entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Caro Sureda, 3rd Marquis of La Romana was a Spanish Army officer and nobleman who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. His two younger brothers, José Caro Sureda, and Juan Caro Sureda also served in the Spanish army during the Peninsular War.
